definitions.explanation: The very early hours of the morning, typically from dawn until around 7 or 8 AM. More formal and specific than {朝|あさ}.

examples.japanese: {早朝|そうちょう}から{仕事|しごと}を{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I started work from early morning.

examples.japanese: {早朝|そうちょう}のジョギングは{気持|きも}ちがいい。
examples.english: Jogging in the early morning feels good.

examples.japanese: {早朝|そうちょう}{便|びん}で{出発|しゅっぱつ}する。
examples.english: I'll depart on the early morning flight.

examples.japanese: {早朝|そうちょう}の{公園|こうえん}は{静|しず}かで{空気|くうき}がきれいだ。
examples.english: The park in the early morning is quiet and the air is clean.

examples.japanese: {早朝|そうちょう}に{目|め}が{覚|さ}めてしまい、{二度|にど}と{眠|ねむ}れなかった。
examples.english: I woke up in the early morning and couldn't fall back asleep.

notes:
REGISTER: More formal/written than {朝|あさ}{早|はや}く.

TIME OF DAY EXPRESSIONS:
- {早朝|そうちょう} (early morning, ~5-8 AM)
- {朝|あさ} (morning)
- {午前|ごぜん} (AM, before noon)
- {昼|ひる} (noon, daytime)
- {午後|ごご} (PM, afternoon)
- {夕方|ゆうがた} (evening)
- {夜|よる} (night)
- {深夜|しんや} (late night)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早朝|そうちょう}から (from early morning)
- {早朝|そうちょう}に (in the early morning)
- {早朝|そうちょう}{便|びん} (early morning flight)
